# 3. Celestial Sphere polities (Middle Kingdom IO or East Asian core regions)
oe_ai3_celestial_sphere = {
	base = country
	conditions = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		OR = {
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
			capital = {
				OR = {
					region = region:north_china_region
					region = region:east_china_region
					region = region:south_china_region
					region = region:west_china_region
					region = region:korea_region
					region = region:manchuria_region
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# 4. Mediterranean maritime & basin powers
oe_ai3_mediterranean_powers = {
	base = country
	conditions = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		num_of_ports >= 3
		OR = {
			has_presence_in = region:balkan_region
			has_presence_in = region:anatolia_region
			has_presence_in = region:italy_region
			has_presence_in = region:egypt_region
			has_presence_in = region:maghreb_region
			has_presence_in = region:iberia_region
		}
	}
}

# 5. Proto-industrial & industrial hubs
oe_ai3_industrial_hubs = {
	base = country
	conditions = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		num_locations >= 15
		OR = {
			has_embraced_institution = institution:manufactories
			has_embraced_institution = institution:industrialization
			any_owned_location = {
				has_building = building_type:oe_stm_steam_ironworks
			}
		}
	}
}

# 6. Oceanic & global-trade maritime empires
oe_ai3_maritime_empires = {
	base = country
	conditions = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		num_of_ports >= 8
		OR = {
			navy_size >= 25
			has_colonial_charters = yes
			has_embraced_institution = institution:global_trade
		}
	}
}
